text: Explain a technical concept using general knowledge.
Why does this system behave that way? Give me an explanation, not live data.
Tell me a stable fact or help me understand an idea.
Work out this arithmetic expression and return the numeric result.
Calculate a percentage, sum, product, division, or square root.
Do this deterministic math for me.
Convert a physical measurement from one unit into another.
How many of one measurement unit equals this amount in another unit?
Change a distance, mass, volume, temperature, or speed into different units.
Tell me the current clock time in a place or timezone.
What time is it right now at this location?
Give me the live local time for a city.
Convert a supplied clock time from one timezone to another.
If it is this time in one place, what time is that somewhere else?
Translate a UTC or local timestamp into another timezone.
Convert money between two currencies using a live or dated exchange rate.
How much money in one currency is worth in another currency?
Look up a foreign exchange rate or convert an amount of money.
Tell me the current weather conditions at a location.
What is happening outside now: temperature, rain, wind, or conditions?
Check the live weather right now for this place.
Tell me what the weather will be later or on a future day.
Will rain, heat, cold, or other conditions happen during a future time window?
Give me the forecast so I can decide what to do later.
Give me the live or recent result or score of a sports game.
Did this team win, lose, or what is the score?
Check the current or most recent game result for a team or event.
Tell me when a team plays next or show upcoming fixtures.
What is the upcoming sports schedule or start time?
Find the next match or game for this team.
Give me the current price or quote for a stock, index, or cryptocurrency.
What is this financial asset trading at right now?
Check the live market value or today's price movement.
Search the open web for current external information that has no dedicated structured source.
Find the latest information online or discover sources about this topic.
Use web search to look up a recent release, announcement, news item, or changing fact.
Read a specific web page or source and extract information from its contents.
Open this URL and summarize or inspect the actual page.
Read the chosen source after search because the page contents are needed.
Retrieve something the user or project said, chose, or discussed previously.
Look up relevant prior conversation or remembered project context.
Recall an earlier decision, preference, plan, or fact from memory.
Read the current state of a Newo device or runtime property without changing it.
Check whether a device feature is on, connected, muted, or what its current value is.
Inspect live device status only; do not modify anything.
Change a device setting or perform a mutating device action.
Turn a device feature on or off, or set its value.
Control Newo hardware or change speaker, voice, or runtime state.
Read current local sensor, RF, CSI, motion, distance, or signal data.
What is this sensor detecting right now?
Inspect a live hardware sensing measurement or signal state.
Inspect the current camera view and answer a visual question about the scene.
Look through Newo2's camera and tell me what is visible now.
Use the live camera to identify or describe what I am showing you.
